idea-plugin.name: SpEL Injection Sink Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Spring ExpressionParser.parseExpression(...) call whose argument is built from an HTTP endpoint parameter -- CWE-917 (Expression Language Injection), the exact mechanism CVE-2022-22963 (Spring Cloud Function) exploited: an attacker's raw input becomes SpEL SOURCE TEXT, re-parsed and evaluated as an expression. Also flags a hardcoded, compile-time-constant expression whose parsed AST references a dangerous T(...) type (Runtime, ProcessBuilder, System).

Built on a real, hand-written SpEL parser -- the second full custom grammar in this catalog (after the ReDoS Catastrophic-Backtracking Companion's own regex grammar), never depending on Spring itself being on the classpath.

Stated honestly: real competitors exist for the general category (CodeQL, batch/CI only, not inline IDE; Datadog Code Security, a JetBrains plugin but one rule among 500+ in an enterprise SAST requiring a Datadog account/subscription; Qodana taint analysis, requires a paid Ultimate Plus license, not Community Edition) -- none is a free, zero-account, Community-Edition-compatible, single-purpose plugin for this exact finding.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: SpEL expression built from untrusted input or hardcoded dangerous type
